description: Run multiple commands in parallel and return all results. Each command is a binary plus an args array, executed without a shell (for a pipeline use command='sh', args=['-c', '...']). Use when you need to gather independent pieces of information in a single tool call instead of multiple sequential calls.

command.description: The binary to execute — NOT a shell string (e.g. 'git', 'sh'). For pipes/redirects, use command='sh' with args=['-c', '<script>'].

label.description: Label for this command in the results (defaults to the command name)

name: batch
title: Run commands in parallel
